newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms buy 50,000T Brazilian soybean.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms buy 50,000T Brazilian soybean.

text.p: Two South Korean edible oil producers bought a total of 50,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybean from Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp in a private negotiation, officials at the two companies said on Friday.
The two firms are Cheiljedang Corp and Sam Yang Foods Co Ltd. Cheiljedang bought 40,000 tonnes and Sam Yang took the remaining 10,000 tonnes.
They said the purchase was made at a basis price over July futures on the Chicago Board of Trade.
Shipment was set for May 1-20 to the South Korea's western port of Inchon.
